title: Senate cuts impeachment livestream over BIR data privacy concerns

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate cut its livestream of the first half of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Friday due to concerns about the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) officers’s data privacy Presiding Officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero ruled to act after BIR chief of staff Atty. Anne Loraine Garcia-Marquez pointed out that the defense displayed Letters of Authority containing revenue officers’ names. “The chair has already ordered the clerk of court to take down the original live stream and re-upload it with the redaction of the names of the revenue officers,” Escudero told the court.
